youtrackUrl.description: The base URL of your YouTrack instance.

query.description: YouTrack search query to filter issues (e.g., 'project: MyProject State: Open').

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve (e.g., 'id,summary,description,state').

max.description: Maximum number of issues to retrieve.

success.description: True if the operation was successful, false otherwise.

error.description: Error message if the operation failed.
